dataset_1.name: Broad Crop Disease Dataset (Dataset 1)
dataset_1.image_modality: Predominantly controlled-background laboratory photographs (detached leaves mounted on uniform gray/black paper boards under flat artificial lighting). Minor real-world field images in field_test.
dataset_1.class_balance: Strictly artificial balance: exactly 70 images per class.
dataset_1.independence_risk: High risk of specimen leakage if test set contains different angles of the same physical leaf specimen photographed in the PlantVillage laboratory.

dataset_2.name: Andhra Pradesh Master Regional Dataset (Dataset 2)
dataset_2.provenance: Regional farm survey & field extension collections in Andhra Pradesh and Telangana.
dataset_2.image_modality: Real-world field photographs taken with mobile devices under natural outdoor illumination, featuring complex backgrounds (soil, weeds, hands, sky, shadows, irrigation furrows) and variable resolutions.
plant_organs_represented: Fruit / Pods (Chilli pods, Mango fruit, Banana bunches)
dataset_2.class_balance: Highly imbalanced: ranges from 25 images (Palm_Fungal Disease) and 40 images (Rice_Leaf Smut) up to 500 images per class (Mango, Banana, Tomato, Rice).

ambiguous_or_unsupported_classes: Palm_Fungal Disease (25 images - generic undifferentiated tag)

cross_dataset_comparison.domain_shift_impact: Severe. Dataset 1 lab leaves create a massive domain gap when evaluated alongside Dataset 2 outdoor farm photos. Training a unified model without domain adaptation or crop routing resulted in Dataset 1 validation accuracy collapsing from 99.2% to 35.3%.
